notes.title: Update 20230427.1020
notes.content:
Club Environment Preview
 We've been working on an all-new club environment, which is now available for preview!
[list]
[*] At this stage, performances are disabled for the club, but you can explore the environment.
[*] Access the club by using the portal to the right of the clothing shop.
[*] Let us know what you think!
[/list]

New Emote Menu
[list]
[*] Dances can now be accessed via the 'B' keybind and selected using the radial menu.
[*] The previous 'E' keybind has been disabled
[/list]

[list]
[*] Client size reduced from 12GB to 7GB
[*] Additional optimisations in the city level
[*] Server stability has been improved.
[*] You can no longer clap for your own performance
[*] Additional bug fixes 
[/list]
